cues: On first meeting an antigen, the immune system takes five to ten days to respond, and the antibody level stays small.
On a second meeting, memory cells are waiting: the response comes in one to three days and is a hundred to a thousand times stronger.
A vaccine gives you that first meeting safely, so the real infection meets the second response.
